title: 第021章 骨剑诛凶胎苏辰的强悍战力第022章 这是储物戒指确定不是随身停尸房
slug: 九叔饲养百倍返还僵尸成旱魃
content_zh:
李月盈腹中那团青黑影子猛地贴住肚皮。
一张婴儿脸隔着皮肉凸了出来。
五官扭曲，嘴巴裂开，像是在无声尖叫。
李月盈双手捂着肚子，整个人往后仰倒。
“啊！！！”
她的惨叫声在院子里炸开。
肚皮一鼓一鼓，像里面有什么东西正在用头撞，用手撕。
布料被撑得紧绷，几处针脚直接裂开。
一只小小的黑手印从肚皮下顶起。
五根指头细长，指甲尖得像钩子。
叮铃铃！
张清辞继续摇铃。
她伤势未愈，每摇一下，脸色就白上一分。
可她眼神没有退。
铃音越急，那鬼胎挣扎越凶。
李月盈在地上翻滚，指甲抓着青砖，抓得指缝里全是血。
“停下！停下啊！”
她嘶声尖叫。
“你这个贱人！你敢杀我！你敢杀我的孩子！！”
这句话一出口，院中几人的眼神都变了。

张清辞脸上的最后一点波动彻底散去。
张星野冷哼一声。
“到这时候还说是被害？”
他长剑一抖，脚下猛地发力，冲向李月盈。
也就在这一瞬，李月盈腹部猛地一鼓。
嘶啦！
衣料裂开。
一团青黑鬼影从她肚皮上浮出来。
那鬼影只有婴儿大小，却拖着长长的阴气尾巴，脑袋几乎占了半个身子，嘴巴裂到耳根，满口细密黑牙！
它没有完全破腹而出，半截魂影还连在李月盈腹中。
可那股阴煞气已经扑面而来。
张星野一剑斩下。
鬼婴尖叫一声，身子一扭，竟从剑锋下滑了过去，张口咬向张星野手腕。
张星野手腕一翻，剑柄反磕。
砰！
剑柄砸在鬼影脑袋上，砸出一团黑雾。
鬼婴被打得倒飞，又立刻顺着李月盈肚腹钻回半截，下一息从另一侧扑出。
速度快得像一团黑线。
content_en:
The green and black shadow in Li Yueying's belly suddenly pressed against her belly.
A baby's face protruded through the flesh.
His facial features were distorted and his mouth was split open, as if he was screaming silently.
Li Yueying covered her stomach with both hands and fell back.
"Ah!!!"
Her screams exploded in the yard.
The belly bulges and bulges, as if there is something inside that is being banged with the head and torn apart with the hands.
The fabric was stretched so tight that several stitches were torn apart.
A small black handprint rose from under his belly.
The five fingers are long and slender, and the nails are pointed like hooks.
Jingle bell bell!
Zhang Qingci continued to ring the bell.
Her injury has not healed, and her face turns whiter every time she shakes it.
But her eyes didn't retreat.
The more urgent the ringing sound, the more ferociously the ghost fetus struggles.
Li Yueying rolled on the ground, grabbing the blue bricks with her fingernails until her fingers were filled with blood.
"Stop! Stop!"
she screamed.
"You bitch! How dare you kill me! How dare you kill my child!!"
As soon as these words were spoken, the eyes of several people in the courtyard changed.
The last fluctuation on Zhang Qingci's face completely dissipated.
Zhang Xingye snorted coldly.
"You're still saying you were killed at this point?"
He shook his long sword, exerted force on his feet, and rushed towards Li Yueying.
At this moment, Li Yueying's abdomen suddenly bulged.
Hiss!
The fabric is torn.
A green and black ghost figure emerged from her belly.
The ghost was only the size of a baby, but it was dragging a long yin tail. Its head took up almost half of its body, and its mouth was split from ear to ear, full of fine black teeth!
It didn't completely burst out of the belly, and half of the soul was still attached to Li Yueying's belly.
But the evil spirit has already hit his face.
Zhang Xingye slashed it down with one sword.
The ghost baby screamed, twisted his body, slipped from the edge of the sword, and bit Zhang Xingye's wrist.
Zhang Xingye turned his wrist and knocked the hilt of his sword.
Bang!
The hilt of the sword hit the ghost's head, creating a cloud of black mist.
The ghost baby was knocked upside down, and immediately burrowed halfway back along Li Yueying's belly, then jumped out from the other side with the next breath.
The speed is as fast as a black line.
